propositions: s3_doctor._git calls gitutil.run_git directly without retry wrapper, leaving transient object-DB read failures fatal while identical faults are self-healed elsewhere in the store
Three CI runs failed identically with 'fatal: bad object HEAD' during git bundle create in merge commit heal, caused by the merge commit's loose object becoming temporarily unreadable
The exact failure signature was reproduced by making the merge commit's loose object unreadable immediately before the bundle call, confirming the mechanism but not the runner-side trigger
s3_doctor._git must route through gitutil.run_git_write to inherit the per-store advisory lock, index/ref-lock retry, and transient read-fault retry
The transient missing-object signature 'bad object' must be added to gitutil's transient marker family as a scoped extension to _TRANSIENT_HEAD_MARKERS
Error reporting must distinguish object-DB read failure from heads conflict, so the operator hint correctly describes the failure rather than directing to fsck-recover
